name: spreadsheetSetCellHyperlink
description: Adds a hyperlink to a cell.

params.name: hyperlinkInfo
params.description: Struct with keys row, column, address and type (url, email or document).

rustcfml.notes: Not supported on wasm32. Uses a different signature: spreadsheetSetCellHyperlink(spreadsheetObj, link, row, column [, tooltip]). An empty cell shows the link as its text. Member form: setCellHyperlink(link, row, column, tooltip).

examples.title: RustCFML: Add a hyperlink
examples.description: Link B2 to example.com with a tooltip.
